dedupe_keys.name: cynap cyprus national access point for transport data

description: The Cyprus National Access Point (CyNAP) is an open-access data portal that offers transport-related data free of charge in digital machine-readable formats, helping Cyprus meet its obligations under ITS Directive 2010/40/EU and its delegated regulations. It provides real-time data such as congestion levels, vehicle speeds and a public transport live feed; traffic events and roadworks; regulations and restrictions such as axle weight, bridge height and speed limits; and infrastructure data such as road network topology and recharging and refuelling points. In its first phase it works as a data warehouse, to be extended with metadata and discovery services, and datasets are grouped by publishing organisation. Coverage: Cyprus. Format and access: open portal. Licence and cost: free of charge. Caveats: the home page does not list update rates. It supports network flow and emergency response studies on Cypriot roads. It relates to the EU list of national access points and DATEX II in the catalogue.
name: CyNAP: Cyprus National Access Point for transport data
